# Dias Accounting and Tax Consulting LLC
> FTA-Registered Tax Agency and Chartered Accounting firm headquartered in Sharjah Media City (SHAMS) and serving Dubai Mainland, DIFC, DTEC, DMCC, IFZA, and all UAE jurisdictions. Led by FTA-Registered Tax Agent Glen Dias, providing fixed-fee monthly IFRS bookkeeping, 5% UAE VAT Form 201 filings, 9% UAE Corporate Tax returns, 0% Small Business Relief (SBR) & 0% Qualifying Free Zone Person (QFZP) advisory, statutory dividend audits, and turnkey UAE company formation starting from AED 400/month.
